title: Sterile Egg
description: Eggs are added that can be eaten.You can get it by sterilizing regular eggs with a sterilizer. 加入可以食用的鸡蛋。你可以用消毒器给普通鸡蛋消毒来获取它。
body:
加入可以食用的鸡蛋（无菌蛋），你可以用消毒器给普通鸡蛋消毒来获取它。
Eggs are added that can be eaten.You can get it by sterilizing regular eggs with a sterilizer.
当然，你也会吃到坏掉的鸡蛋。
Of course, you will also eat a bad egg.
你也可以投掷它。
You can also throw it.
消毒器需要红石信号才能工作。
The sterilizer requires a redstone signal to work.
普通的鸡蛋也可食用，但是吃到坏蛋的几率更大。
Regular eggs are also edible, but the chance of eating bad eggs is greater.
Shift+右键以食用普通鸡蛋或投掷无菌蛋。
Shift+Right-click to eat a regular egg or toss a sterile egg.
